title: The Clock of the Palatinate
author: Astrid Zhou
blurb: Tamsin Amberdale, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
